description_nl: 2026-10-07: s.6(1): resident with 182 days in the year, or 60 days in the year and 365 in the 4 before - the 60 days being 182 for a citizen who left for a job abroad or as a ship's crew (Explanation 1(a)) and for a citizen / person of Indian origin on a visit (Explanation 1(b)), 120 for such a visitor whose income other than from foreign sources is over 15 lakh. s.6(1A): a citizen with such income over 15 lakh not liable to tax in any other country is deemed resident. s.6(6): not ordinarily resident - non-resident in 9 of the 10 years before, or in India 729 days or less in the 7 before (a), the 120-day visitor (c), the deemed resident (d). Without the days, the yes / no answer decides.
